title: Headless Stealing Independence (MS15, TTW 3.4): from Abraham Washington's job to the Declaration of Independence handed over (stage 100)

actions.text: Given: the player is out of Vault 101 in the Capital Wasteland, Following in His Footsteps (MQ01) at its first stage (10) [observed]. MS15 is Start Game Enabled [observed]; the player meets Abraham Washington in Rivet City's Capital Preservation Society.

Path (alone, the real Declaration): Abraham Washington's talk of the Declaration to the job (MS15QuestYes: stage 10, QuestTold, OnMission); at the National Archives the Rotunda trigger brings the super mutants (MS15RotundaWaveTriggerScript: stage 30); their five deaths (SMDeathCount 5) end the defence (40); near the strongroom entry (MS15ArchivesStrongroomEntryMarker, 400 units) the quest sets 50; the Declaration is taken (MS15DeclarationFinalRefScript OnAdd: stage 60); Washington takes it (MS15TLGotIt: stage 100, 400 caps). Sydney's help (SydneyJoin) and Button Gwinnett's forgery are not played. [observed: MS15 stage, INFO and object scripts on the TTW load order]
Stand-in for the walk to the National Archives and into the Rotunda: its trigger sets 30 and sends the super mutants in.

Stand-in for the fight: the five Rotunda super mutants (the first three, then the two the quest script enables after two deaths) die by the player's hand; each one's death counts SMDeathCount and the fifth sets 40.
Stand-in for the way down to the strongroom: within 400 units of its entry marker the quest script (run every 5 s, its default delay) sets 50.

Stand-in for getting past Button Gwinnett and his robots (the pilot's fight) to the Declaration's wall safe: its contents are taken; the Declaration's OnAdd (MS15DeclarationFinalRefScript, QuestTold 1) sets 60 and gives the safe password note.
Stand-in for the walk back to Rivet City. Washington takes the Declaration and pays (MS15TLGotIt: stage 100).
